options.title: Role
options.description: What role should the AI have?

choices.label: Assistant
choices.description: Will act as your assistant helping you on your sissy journey. It wont decide or plan independently, rather help you and follow your instructions.

choices.label: Trainer
choices.description: Will train into a sissy. Will plan and make decisions on its own.

choices.label: Roleplay
choices.description: Will choose/create a character and play the role of a dominant.
